claude_proposed_widenings.name: CastTimeEffectModeChoice.options[].duration
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Minor Creation lasts 'until the end of your next turn' while the spell's overall header duration is 1 hour. CastTimeEffectModeChoice option entries have no duration field, so there is no honest way to express that a specific effect mode expires earlier than the host spell's lifecycle. Including create_object or create_illusion in the Minor Creation option without a per-option duration would misrepresent the lifecycle in the tracer.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Minor Creation: 'It lasts until the end of your next turn.'

claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpellMechanics.maxConcurrentInstances (or OngoingEffectMechanics equivalent)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Prestidigitation can be cast repeatedly; the non-instantaneous effects from prior casts persist and stack. The spell imposes a cap of 3 simultaneously active non-instantaneous effects. No field on ActivationMechanics, OngoingEffectMechanics, or SpellMechanics tracks a per-spell-identity concurrent-instance limit.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time.
